# [TASK] ai-service: token/span breakdown on the query-parsing response

## Task
Extend the query-parsing endpoint's response with a token/span breakdown so
the frontend can highlight without doing its own NLP.

## Parent Story
Parent: #199

## Scope
Response shape only — reuses #198's existing parsing endpoint/logic, adds a
field to its response.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Response includes a list of `{ text, category, start, end }` spans covering connectors (and/or), negations, and entities (person/year/genre/collaborator)
- [x] Span offsets are byte/char-accurate against the original submitted text (verified with non-ASCII input, e.g. accented names)
- [x] Plain-title queries return an empty or single-entity span list, not an error
- [x] Unit tests assert exact span boundaries for at least one multi-category query

## Estimate
**Hours:** 4

## Implementation
`QueryParsingService.parseWithSpans` calls the existing `#202` extraction,
then `QuerySpanExtractor` computes spans deterministically (plain string
search over the already-extracted filter, not asked of the model — offsets
must be exact, and a generative model can't reliably self-report character
positions). `POST /api/v1/ai/search/query` now returns
`QueryParseResponseDto{filter, spans}`. Offsets are UTF-16 code-unit
offsets (char-accurate; not byte offsets — matches JS string indexing so
the frontend can slice its own field value directly).
